subject: Social Media
title: Shadowbanning
description: A quick, practical guide to Shadowbanning.

hook.text: You post every day, but nobody sees it. Your content exists—it's just invisible. You've been shadowbanned.

buildup.text: Shadowbanning reduces a user's visibility without telling them. Posts appear normal to the creator but reach no one.

discovery.text: Platforms deny it exists. Yet researchers have documented systematic suppression of certain content types and voices.

twist.text: It's the perfect censorship. The silenced person doesn't even know they're silent. They just think nobody cares.

climax.text: Without transparency, nobody can prove it happened. The algorithm is judge, jury, and executioner—in secret.

quiz.question: What makes shadowbanning particularly effective as censorship?
options: The user doesn't know they've been silenced
